places.name: Elizabeth Furnace
places.access: George Washington NF day-use area, mid-April to October, sunrise to sunset; the Buzzard Rocks lot is small.

places.name: Shenandoah: Little Stony Man
places.access: Park entrance fee. Parts of the cliff closed all year, others about May to July for peregrines; no tree anchors.

places.name: Shenandoah: Old Rag
places.access: Park entrance fee and an Old Rag day-use ticket (Recreation.gov) Mar 1 to Nov 30; no road-shoulder parking.
